simple.meaning: עֹרֶם (ʻôrem) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a stratagem.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 5:13. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹרֶם (H6193) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עֹרֶם (ʻôrem) / H6193 is traced through Job 5:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6193. orem [ עֹ֫רֶם ] noun [masculine] craftiness ; — suffix בְּעָרְמָם Job 5:13 (possibly from עָרְמָה Ges § 91e and others).

occurrences.englishText: He takes the wise in their own craftiness;
